## Space for a clear idea

A useful reader gives the words room to breathe. The title, date, and images establish a rhythm without competing with the article. This paragraph is deliberately long enough to check the comfortable reading measure on a desktop and the line wrapping on a phone.

> Readability comes first. The framing should support the writing.
